### John Locke on equality

John Locke (1632–1704) approaches equality within Empiricism. The mind at birth is without innate speculative principles; ideas come from sensation and reflection. Primary qualities resemble external powers; secondary qualities do not. On this page, the archive isolates English passages where that project meets equality most directly—useful for searches such as “john locke quotes on equality.”
